items.ru: На отдельных программах нужно пройти тесты способностей, возможностей и навыков; какие это программы и когда тесты, сказано в Call for Enrolment.
items.evidence: To enrol in certain degree programmes, candidates are required to pass tests of ability, capacity and skills. The degree programmes at the University of Ljubljana that require such tests, and their test dates, are published in the Call for Enrolment and on the website www.uni-lj.si/en/study/bachelorsand-single-cycle-masters-study/call-for-enrolment.

items.ru: Сертификат словенского языка B2 нужен на части программ — медицина, фармация, право, журналистика, психология и другие; полный список в брошюре.
items.evidence: E-copy/scan of the evidence of the Slovenian language examination at B2 level if enrolling at the University of Ljubljana on degree programmes of Academy for Theatre, Radio, Film and Television, Faculty of Pharmacy, Faculty of Medicine (exam passed at ALTE-approved Centres for Slovenian Language Examinations), Faculty of Law, Faculty of Health Sciences, the Professional Degree programme in Business Administration at the School of Economics and Business, the Administration programme at the Faculty of Administration, the Journalism programme at the Faculty of Social Studies, the Slovenian Language programme, Psychology, Comparative Literature and Literary Theory at the Faculty of Arts, Pedagogical Mathematics at the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics, and the Interdisciplinary Professional program Biopharmaceutical Engineering (UL FFA, BF, FKKT, FRI).

items.ru: Прямое собеседование о пригодности к программе проходят граждане стран с повышенным миграционным риском, которым нужна виза в ЕС; Казахстан в списке.
items.evidence: Applicants who are citizens of countries with a higher migration risk and who require visas to cross the European Union external borders, must undergo a direct interview on their suitability for enrolment in the degree programme in accordance with the enrolment conditions before further professional and administrative consideration. Candidates will receive more detailed information about the interview from higher education institutions after the application deadline.

note: Брошюра описывает набор 2026/2027; приём закрыт, следующий период — февраль 2027. Документы (аттестат, переводы, паспорт) не внесены — они в data/prep. Тесты, сертификат B2 и интервью — только для части программ или граждан.
